title: Layered FX hedge plan
prompt:
Evaluate Alder Ridge's currency-specific forward, option, and residual-unhedged program.

Begin with the July liquidity, banking, and covenant-outlook thread in `Requests/`, including the bank follow-up. Work through the shared finance folders as an Alder Ridge analyst would: identify the current controller-tied workpapers, retain prior versions only for comparison, and resolve source authority from dates, approvals, document status, and the management correspondence. Several nearby files are earlier working versions or belong to a different reporting purpose. Reconcile any Alder Ridge posted baseline through the contractor-accounting MCP; external target, peer, bank, or market evidence remains controlled by the applicable finance source and must not be forced into Alder Ridge's ledger.

This is an independently reset assignment. Recompute the analysis from the shared company sources and do not rely on a deliverable produced by another task.

Translate each committed payable with the correct USD-per-foreign-unit quote. Price forwards at their contracted rates, purchased options at the better of scenario spot and strike for a payable plus premium, and residual exposure at scenario spot; use the budget rate as expected-case spot and the downside rate as downside spot. Test the unhedged cap by exposure and compare fully layered downside cash cost with budget.

Do not modify files or post transactions. Also apply same-currency natural offsets and test counterparty notional limits before recomputing downside cash cost.

Return only one JSON object with exactly these keys: `budget_usd_cost`, `layered_expected_usd_cost`, `layered_downside_usd_cost`, `downside_variance_to_budget`, `total_option_premium`, `unhedged_budget_value`, `hedge_policy_compliant`, `budget_variance_alert_triggered`, `net_budget_fx_exposure`, `natural_hedge_budget_benefit`, `downside_cost_after_natural_offsets`, `downside_variance_after_natural_offsets`, `largest_downside_currency_exposure`, `bank_A_budget_hedge_notional`, `counterparty_limit_compliant`. Use dollars to two decimals, ratios and percentages as decimal ratios to at least four decimals, and lists as JSON arrays.
